whyMatters.en: Austin instrumental quartet whose The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003) set US delay-guitar crescendo grammar beside Mogwai/Godspeed.
whyMatters.zh: 奥斯汀器乐四重奏；The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place（2003）在 Mogwai/Godspeed 旁定下美国延时吉他 crescendo 语法。

essentialTracks.title: The Birth and Death of the Day

shortBio.en: Wordless post-rock; Your Hand in Mine is the signature crescendo.
shortBio.zh: 无人声 post-rock；Your Hand in Mine 是标志 crescendo。

body.en:
Formed 1999 in Austin. The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003, Temporary Residence) fixed delay-heavy interlocking guitars, soft-to-loud arcs, and film/TV licensing reach.

Your Hand in Mine (2003) is the entry cue—no vocals, narrative in arrangement dynamics. Three guitarists plus bass/drums; room and 延音 carry the melody.
body.zh:
1999 年于奥斯汀组建。The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place（2003，Temporary Residence）定型大量延时交织吉他、弱到强弧线，以及影视授权触达。

Your Hand in Mine（2003）是入口——无人声，叙事在编曲动态。三吉他加贝斯/鼓；空间与 延音 扛旋律。

note.en: Interlocking delay guitars—Earth signature build, Friday Night Lights sync.
note.zh: 交织延时吉他——Earth 标志渐强，Friday Night Lights 同步。

note.zh: 三吉他 延音 堆叠至峰值——专辑最响 crescendo 时刻。

note.zh: 干净琶音开场——Earth A 面慢燃模板。

title.zh: 美国延时吉他 crescendo 摇滚

body.en:
Explosions in the Sky matter for exporting Mogwai-style crescendo to American indie via Temporary Residence and TV sync.

The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003) is the cited album—five tracks, all instrumental.

Your Hand in Mine became Friday Night Lights shorthand.

Three guitars interlock in delay; drums stay relatively dry.
body.zh:
Explosions in the Sky 要紧处是经 Temporary Residence 与电视同步把 Mogwai 式 crescendo 出口到美国 indie。

The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place（2003）是被引专辑——五曲，全器乐。

Your Hand in Mine 成 Friday Night Lights 简写。

三吉他在延时里交织；鼓相对干。

body.en:
1999–present unchanged: Rayani, Smith, Hrasky, James—three guitarists including James on bass/guitar duties live.

No vocalist across the catalog; song titles carry narrative hint.

Early DIY Texas shows built the interlocking delay method before Earth studio polish.

Later albums (All of a Sudden I Miss Everyone, Take Care…) extend runtimes and tour scale.
body.zh:
1999 至今未变：Rayani、Smith、Hrasky、James——三吉他含 James 现场贝斯/吉他分工。

全目录无人声；曲名承载叙事暗示。

早期德州 DIY 现场建立交织延时法，Earth 录音室抛光之前。

后期专辑（All of a Sudden I Miss Everyone、Take Care…）延长时长与巡演规模。

title.en: Instrumental rock in film and TV

body.en:
Explosions in the Sky normalized wordless crescendo rock for US sync licensing alongside Mogwai/Godspeed.

Sonic Youth’s tunings and textural guitar are the named ancestor.

Your Hand in Mine and First Breath After Coma remain entry tracks for post-rock curious listeners.

Influence is format—long builds, delay 延音—not rock-star persona.
body.zh:
Explosions in the Sky 与 Mogwai/Godspeed 并行，把无人声 crescendo 摇滚正常化进美国同步授权。

Sonic Youth 定弦与质感吉他是点名祖先。

Your Hand in Mine 与 First Breath After Coma 仍是 post-rock 好奇者的入口曲。

影响在格式——长推进、延时 延音——非摇滚明星人设。

body.en: Interlocking delay guitars—Earth signature build, Friday Night Lights sync.
body.zh: 交织延时吉他——Earth 标志渐强，Friday Night Lights 同步。
